mapper.select: SELECT am.user_id AS userId, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, 'ACTIVITY' AS sourceType, a.id AS sourceId, a.title FROM activity a INNER JOIN activity_member am ON am.activity_id = a.id WHERE am.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.start_time < #{to} AND a.end_time > #{from} ORDER BY a.start_time
